# R5.36 — Mechanism joins and versioned denominator definitions

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/206_R5.36__metrics.md` (seq 206/246) · §4.1/§4.2 +
AC-4-1 of `docs/evidence-and-adoption-spec.md` (s4 metric families,
windows, reducers, typed negatives) · methods packet M-C ·
**Requirement ids:** REQ-D-005, REQ-D-106, REQ-E-004, REQ-E-107
(primary) · REQ-D-109, REQ-D-310, REQ-E-209, REQ-H-010 (contributing) ·
**Landing record:** ADR-0414

## Summary

Lands the §4.2/M-C **mechanism registry and windowed denominator
machinery** on `hharness-eval` — additive projections plus a new
read-only fold module (no RPC, no schema source, no new dependency,
no new event class, no store/dispatch authority). `facts.rs` gains the
join coordinate and the window bound: `seq` on `EffectRow`/
`ArtefactRow`, and `LedgerFacts.subject_stop_seq` — the earliest
durable post-execution boundary, `min` over the first
`action.environment.phase.changed{to: verify|teardown}`, the first
`control.decision{kind:"stop"}` and `lifecycle.run.finished`
(`ledger_facts/1` codec admits both additive members under the same
strict `reject_unknown`; `None` ⇒ `no_detector`, never an unbounded
guess). `mechanism.rs` (new) carries `MECHANISM_REGISTRY` — 21
versioned rows declared before collection (name/version/family/
native unit/bounds/direction/detector id/reducer/windowed/required),
the closed `MechanismOutcome` honest vocabulary
(`Value{num,den}|Count|NoDetector|EstimatorUndefined|Inapplicable`),
the windowed detectors retaining `(c,event)` `MechanismJoin`s —
reacquisition intensity (repeated deliveries count, never clamped),
exact idempotency-key repeated action, next-dispatch request-change,
recall/extractor, summary-followed, same-unit overhead — the declared-
metadata subject input (nothing inferred: eligible opportunities,
trigger, intended variant, extractable set, labels, summary, opacity,
subject totals), and the `subject_ratio→task_mean→equal_task` reducers
(`w_t = 1/T`; unpaired tasks retained beside, never folded). The
family report keeps every required member, `unavailable` included;
the retired similarity heuristic stays under its own distinct
non-required name. `tests/r5_36.rs` (5/5) hand-counts every reported
numerator/denominator on golden fixtures — overlapping compactions,
one delivery joining both windows, intensity `Value{5,4}` > 1, exact
vs non-matching keys, missing key/extractor, zero denominators,
absent summary, post-execution exclusion, and the −0.625 two-task
equal-task contrast. Predecessor contracts consumed unchanged (R5.15
slots, R5.20 retained view, `context_metrics` fold); $0 spend;
offline only.

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**1,564 changed source/test lines vs the ≤850 trigger (~1.8×)** —
recorded Deviation, accepted per the scoped AMEND ruling
`326c10aa` (`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.36-split-review.md`):
the M-C packet binds all six §4.2 metric families to one scope
sentence (no contingency; the packet family writes contingencies
verbatim where intended — M-A/E-207/F-005 carry them) and rules
the keep-together way — "Producer payload changes and math must
remain together when they share event join decisions" (M-C :72).
The proposed primaries-vs-conditionals cut is mid-predicate:
`detect()` is one function emitting the whole 21-key map — leg (a)
ships either a partial family (violating §4.2 required-member
retention) or a `no_detector` stub whose AC-2 cells cannot run
until leg (b); `subject_stop_seq` is the apparatus's own window
bound (existing-contract projection, R5.33 fold-fix class); leg (a)
alone ~1,150 still over — non-curative. Mass is the admitted
registry itself (~330 rows/decls) + detectors/reducers + the golden
battery, not sprawl. Honest trip: review, not redesign.
